realizes.rationale: This gate keeps a refresh_not_current candidate open regardless of an attempted history-row answer.

1.note: Evaluates currentness and satisfying-row conditions for already produced reconsideration items at the registered gate seam. This function does not invent triggers or cascading reconsideration. A satisfying history row alone cannot make a refreshed stale anchor current. Supersession, source observation and row satisfaction remain separate decisions.
